name: Sharanya

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sharanya is an English-language poet from Trivandrum, Kerala. A December 2022 contributor note in Borderless identifies her as a student of English literature and records publications in Madras Courier, Literary Vibes and the Poetry Society of India’s annual anthology. Those details closely match her Kabita Live biography. She appears in these journals as Sharanya B and Sharanya Bee; this page retains her magazine byline.

In “Moving In”, a newly occupied house becomes a way of measuring an absence. A switchboard, exposed cords, dusty marble and the smell of paint give the room an immediate physical presence, while the person the speaker longs for remains out of reach. The poem moves from the possibility of shelter towards an unsettling recognition: a change of address cannot necessarily provide room to escape one’s thoughts.
